map.完全期望寿命把当年内存活片段也计入（连续化），比离散取整期望长约 0.5 岁；精: The complete expectation of life also counts the surviving fraction within the current year (continuous form), so it runs about 0.5 year longer than the discrete rounded expectation; actuarial reserves and annuity pricing need the complete expectation for accuracy.
map.完整 eₓ 直接对 ₜpₓ 加权求和；常用取整期望 eₓ° = Σₜ₌₁^ω ₜ: The complete eₓ is a weighted sum of ₜpₓ; the common rounded expectation eₓ° = Σₜ₌₁^ω ₜpₓ ≈ eₓ − 0.5.
